subject: Request: short intro call — scheduling options for Janelle Wong
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Janelle Wong <janelle.wong@gmail.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 16:32:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short intro call — scheduling options for Janelle Wong

Hi Janelle,

Thanks again for applying to the Software Engineer role at Redwood Inference — I reviewed your profile and we'd love to do a brief 20-minute phone screen to learn more about your background and share a bit about the team.

I realize timezones can be tricky, so below are three options (all in my Pacific time). If none work, please reply with your timezone and 2–3 windows that work on your side.

Option A — Wed Sep 21: 10:00–10:20 AM PT
Option B — Thu Sep 22: 4:00–4:20 PM PT
Option C — Fri Sep 23: 8:00–8:20 AM PT

Interviewer: Markus Klein (Engineering Manager)
Format: 20 min phone / quick technical + culture fit

I attached a short role brief for context. If you can confirm which option you'd prefer (or paste your local-time availability), I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: L4-SWE-Phone-Screen-Brief.pdf

From: Janelle Wong <janelle.wong@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Sep 2028 09:15:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short intro call — scheduling options for Janelle Wong

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick note and for the role brief — really excited about Redwood. I'm based in Singapore (SGT, UTC+8), so the times you listed are a bit awkward on my side. My availability this week (SGT):

• Thu Sep 22: 09:00–11:00 SGT
• Thu Sep 22: 19:00–21:00 SGT (if you need evening)
• Fri Sep 23: 18:00–20:00 SGT

Prefer the morning window if possible. I've re-attached my most recent resume in case the attachment didn't come through earlier.

Also happy to share a short Google Meet link if that works better than phone — whatever is easier for Markus.

Best,
Janelle Wong
janelle.wong@gmail.com
Attachments: Janelle_Wong_Resume.pdf

Hi Janelle — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming your timezone (SGT).

9:30 AM SGT on Thu Sep 22 would map to 6:30 PM PT on Wed Sep 21 for us — that slot works well for Markus and keeps the meeting in the morning for you (your preferred window). I've created a calendar invite and attached the .ics; the event title is “Redwood Intro — Janelle Wong (20m)”. Please accept if that looks good.

Notes for the call: we'll start with a 5–7 minute background discussion, 8–10 minutes of technical conversation (light problem / systems overview), and a few minutes at the end for your questions. If you'd prefer Google Meet instead of a phone call, let me know and I'll update the invite with a Meet link.

Attachments: screen_invite.ics, phone_screen_notes_template.docx

Best,
Marissa
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
